subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.
Keep the green block in the dustpan. Use the right-hand broom and left-hand dustpan to sweep the three remaining blocks in the farther row into the dustpan.
Use the right-hand broom to sweep all four blocks, including the green block beside the lip, into the left-hand dustpan.
Set the broom down on the clear table to the right of the dustpan. Release both supported tools without shifting the loaded pan, then return both empty arms to their respective starting poses.
Leave the tools and blocks on the table. Return both empty open grippers to their original starting poses near the front left and front right bases.
Use the right-hand broom to sweep the magenta block from the dustpan lip into the middle of the dustpan. Keep the other three blocks in the pan.
Lift the broom clear of the dustpan, put it down on the clear table to the right, then return both empty grippers to their starting poses.
